llmJudgeRequirements.description: Store hook is created with `create` from `zustand`
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: FeedStore.ts imports `create` from `zustand` and calls `create<FeedState>(...)` to produce the hook.

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Async fetch action calls `set` to write loading state before awaiting network work
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: `fetchFeed` calls `set({ status: 'loading', error: null })` synchronously before the `await fetch(...)` call.
evidence: store/FeedStore.ts: `set({ status: 'loading', error: null })` precedes `await fetch(...)`

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Async fetch action writes success data and error state through `set` in separate branches
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: The try block calls `set({ items: data.todos, status: 'success' })` and the catch block calls `set({ status: 'error', error: ... })` as separate branches.

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Error UI retry trigger calls the same async store action used by initial fetch
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: The error UI's Retry button calls `reset` (which only resets state to idle) rather than `fetchFeed`, so it does not re-trigger the async fetch action.

llmJudgeRequirements.description: UI output branches by lifecycle status values for idle loading success and error
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: A `statusContent` map keyed by all four lifecycle values (`idle`, `loading`, `success`, `error`) is defined and rendered via `statusContent[status]`.
evidence: App.tsx: `const statusContent = { idle: ..., loading: ..., success: ..., error: ... } satisfies Record<FeedStatus, React.ReactNode>`
